blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Adamson got back in the win column in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament with an 85-57 rout of the University of Santo Tomas on Saturday at Philsports Arena. The Soaring Falcons recovered from their loss to Ateneo to improve to 2-1, while the Growling Tigers fell to 2-2 in their worst loss so far this season. Adamson’s hot start set the tone as it led 19-12 after the opening quarter before stretching the advantage to 50-27 in the third. UST tried to put up a fight with a […]...
